mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_consultation WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY status, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_consultation SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{appointmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_consultation WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND status != 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_consultation (appointment_id,patient_id, doctor_id, patient_name, doctor_name, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId},#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{patientName}, #{doctorName}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW())
